title: Ship and document the qualified real-time SDK and Gallery profile
requires: Any development host; access to current API, schedule and qualification records
scope: Package, deploy and document the qualified single-path SDK and Gallery candidate. Normal simulation creation always uses the fixed-tick architecture; no F8/legacy mode selection remains. Verify installed revision/backend/artifact identities for desktop launchers, Android and iPad. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md; retain historical evidence and all baseline supported interactions.
acceptance: Installed public C/C++ SDK and Gallery tests use normal creation and stepping with no execution-profile request. Every supported domain/interaction uses the same schedule; incompatible API/ABI requests fail clearly.

Publish exact device/workload quality and performance limits and migration instructions for the single architecture; historical evidence is not relabeled and missing integration cannot be hidden as unsupported hardware.

Relocatable packages and installed desktop/mobile applications match the frozen candidate's artifact/revision/backend identities, including the macOS Dock launcher. Material runtime/kernel/API/app changes require candidate refresh and affected requalification.
Show 30/60/high-refresh presentation, bounded long-running memory ownership, lifecycle recovery and ordinary Gallery startup with no user-facing F8 toggle.
